title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, it can affect the Mean Squared Error (MSE) on the training data. Consider how the model's complexity and fit to the training data might change.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: Removing a feature can lead to a simpler model. Think about how this simplification might impact the model's ability to fit the training data.

title: Simplification and Overfitting
text: A simpler model is less likely to overfit the training data. How does this affect the MSE on the training data?

title: Model Fit and MSE
text: If the model fits the training data less well due to the removal of a feature, what is a possible effect on the MSE?

title: Balancing Complexity and Fit
text: Consider the trade-off between model complexity and fit. Removing a feature reduces complexity but might also reduce the model's ability to capture patterns in the training data.
